Definition
[geometrically nonnegative curvature operator] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0133, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0134 1. ch11:11.38\group Positive Curvature Operators An algebraic curvature operator is geometrically nonnegative if it is a finite sum $\sum _\alpha c_\alpha \omega _\alpha \otimes \omega _\alpha $, where $c_\alpha >0$ and every $\omega _\alpha \otimes \omega _\alpha $ satisfies the first Bianchi identity.
